title: Toilet Bench
excerpt: Can AI find a toilet without a sign? Take a photo and help us build the benchmark.
content_html:
Help create the next frontier AI benchmark

Do you know that feeling when you know where the toilet is, even though you are in a place you’ve never visited before and you don't see the toilet sign? That’s human intuition. Help us build a dataset to test whether AI can do the same.

Take a photo with no clear toilet sign
